remainingAcceptance.task: Bind original main-analysis inputs, method contracts and independent source QA to the same 5–10 papers for each of Meta, pharmacovigilance and MR, then run all three rulers and preserve failures. Existing reference arithmetic and question admission do not satisfy this.

V3 requires five qualifying independent full-research reproductions; V4 requires genuine-use outcomes. Publication-after-freeze temporal/prospective results and a complete calendar month are separate prerequisites for the main monthly scientific-success metric.
